claim_one_line: B1656'S CHANNEL NORM IS THE KRONECKER LIMIT OF THE SHIFTED LATTICE AT THE KERNEL'S OWN SHIFT, PLUS pi log Im tau - 2 pi (gamma + log pi) (the SM seat's calibration finding, verified by main on 24 cases to 4.9e-7; replaces B1918, retracted the same day): N(c, tau) = F_u(tau) + pi log Im tau + C with u = c - (1/2, 1/2) and F_u the constant term at s = 1 of the u-shifted lattice sum. The tau-only part is not modular, so the line part F_u carries the geodesic average; P-384's route is open, and the seat's steps 3-4 decide it. 0 of 19.
